name: Omni Grove Park Inn
positioning: The Omni Grove Park Inn & Spa: a resort on 150 acres in the Blue Ridge Mountains, minutes from downtown Asheville, with a subterranean spa, a Donald Ross golf course and Arts and Crafts furnishings
best_for: Spa-focused getaways in the Blue Ridge Mountains
Golfers who want an 18-hole Donald Ross course on site
Travelers who want a mountain resort close to downtown Asheville

facts.text: The resort is set in the Blue Ridge Mountains, just minutes from downtown Asheville.
The resort sits on 150 acres about 2,000 feet above sea level in the Blue Ridge Mountains of western North Carolina.
The resort has an indoor pool and an outdoor pool.
The Sports Complex includes indoor and outdoor tennis courts.
Traditional Rooms are in the historic Main Inn.
Club Rooms on the Club floor include access to continental breakfast and hors d'oeuvres in the Club Lounge.
The resort offers family-friendly resort activities.
The resort is pet friendly for dogs up to 60 pounds.
Elaine's Dueling Piano Bar hosts dueling piano shows, opened by local and regional comedians, Thursday through Saturday.
Entries in the 2026 National Gingerbread House Competition are displayed throughout the resort from November 17, 2026 through January 3, 2027.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2025 and 2026.

highlights.text: The spa occupies 43,000 square feet of subterranean space, with treatments incorporating indigenous elements.
Arts and Crafts furnishings from Stickley and Roycroft are shown throughout guest areas, guestrooms and suites.
Guests can relax in subterranean spa pools.
The resort has a historic 18-hole golf course designed by Donald Ross.
Each of the four signature restaurants offers panoramic views of the Blue Ridge Mountains.

considerations.text: Self and valet parking carry a nightly charge.
The resort is about 17 miles, about 30 minutes, from Asheville Regional Airport.
WhataHotel notes that the mountain location requires planning for seasonal weather.
